eligibility_checks: final conflict HEAD is unchanged on fresh read
reachability proof classifies source stale segment as unreachable from final HEAD chain within the isolated conflict fixture
candidate copies exactly match the source orphan bytes/blob
only isolated candidate copies may be deleted; source historical evidence is preserved
retry_rule: Before each deletion reread authoritative HEAD. Missing candidate means already collected success/no-op. Existing candidate must still match source orphan blob; delete by that fresh observed blob SHA. After interruption, restart from fresh authority and current path existence.
interruption_injection: Delete copy A, persist interruption marker, stop before copy B; retry A as missing-success and delete B; duplicate retry must observe both missing and do no mutation.
